EXIT 1 by design, in both tries and in both languages. The assertion that fails is afterStatus_noteVisible === false.

checks_run.expected: No weakened behaviour. Every re-baseline still asserts its clause literally, or a stricter one.
checks_run.actual:
Product changes: dashboard-facts.ts, reporting dashboards (areas, engine, drilldown, filters, finance), the shared schemas, openapi.yaml, and the web ui.tsx/DashboardsPage/i18n.
Findings in the diff:
• loadOutcomeRows reads status <> 'archived' (D-124 item 1). KBE-R8's kpi-unit-outcomes test asserts that an archived outcome is hidden, and no test relied on draft outcomes being hidden.
• The percentage formatting change applies only to KPI-derived values and to the 'percent'/'%' units. A grep of the reporting emitters shows no non-KPI value with a percent unit, so nothing already scaled is now multiplied by 100.
• The currency filter of the value-state drill-downs follows N4 item 3. The value.investment drill-down with a currency that has no line answers a known zero, which is the ADR's text and not a defect.
• The gap lines include not_applicable lines, which take no part in the combination (combine rank 0). The web's ValueRagLines renders them as Unknown: F-DG4-143.
Re-baselines:
• The KBE-R7 changes (variant A/B, the per-currency RAG now red, the unknown margin line now red under the §3 precedence red > unknown, the value.gap+revenue_uplift 200, multiple_currencies without currency) each follow N4 exactly. Each still asserts its clause, now stricter: assertDrillInvariant also checks gaps, the currency echo and each item's currency.
• The KBE-R8 changes only add kpiUnit to pinned literals; no assertion was dropped.
• One stale header comment: p4-percentage-kpi.spec.ts says the Outcomes area lists only 'active' outcomes, which D-124 item 1 changed. It is a comment only, so not a finding.

summary:
PASS with two new non-blocking findings: F-DG4-143 (Medium) and F-DG4-144 (Low). The round-3 repairs hold as acceptance behaviour on the integrated stack, in EN and AR.
• F-DG4-126: the Value RAG is Red for margin 70 validated beside 300 of unvalidated revenue uplift, with one line per basis and currency.
• F-DG4-127: the Portfolio value is on the profit-and-cash basis (70/90, never 370/435), labelled.
• F-DG4-105: every value href names its currency and drills to exactly that figure.
• F-DG4-125 and D-124: '12 %', '12 % of users', '1.5', the gap '100 %', and API-created outcomes in T10.
Every check ran: static 7/7; unit 4×(2885 + 259, plus 2 skips by design); integration 1975×2, tests/qa 172, DLV-036 85; e2e in both projects and both locale settings. Every full-run failure is explained (30 s timeouts under load, and test-data volume) and passed when re-run alone. The C.UTF-8 full run was stopped by the shell's 2-hour limit at test 365 of 368, and its tail was re-run alone.
New:
• F-DG4-143 (Medium): a not_applicable Value RAG line renders 'Unknown'.
• F-DG4-144 (Low): the business-unit filter's 'too_many' note advises a remedy (phase/status) that cannot lift the block.
